name: Isle of Skye
bestMonths: May and September: long light, midges not yet hatched or already gone. June-Aug brings both crowds and midges
crowd: Fairy Pools and Old Man of Storr queue by 10:00 in summer. Wild camp high and late: the Quiraing at 21:00 is empty
bestView: The Quiraing ridge at golden hour: landslipped pinnacles over the Sound of Raasay, sheep the only company
kid: Fairy pools are a scrambly treasure hunt kids love. Weather turns fast — pack shells. Midges are the honest enemy in July

deep.seasons: May-Sep workable. May and September are the quiet sweet spots. Winter: 6h light, wild weather, empty trails.
deep.notes: Scotland's right-to-roam allows respectful wild camping: small tent, no fire on peat, leave no trace, arrive late leave early. Portree is the food-shop town.

docs.entry: UK: 6-month visa-free entry for many; others need a Standard Visitor visa.
docs.insurance: EHIC/GHIC for UK residents; visitors take normal travel insurance.
special: Waterproof everything: four seasons a day is real
docs.agency: No visas or permits to book here — go direct, the island doesn't need middlemen.
